## India: DPDPA Implementation & Compliance

The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) Secretary S. Krishnan confirmed that there will be no extension for startups to comply with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA), emphasizing the upcoming deadlines for all entities. This underscores the government's firm stance on timely adoption of the new data protection framework. ([Source](https://news.google.?oc=5))

As businesses prepare for DPDPA implementation, discussions highlight the anticipated DPDP Rules 2025, which will provide crucial clarity on various aspects of the Act. Compliance strategies are focusing on integrating data protection with cyber resilience, recognizing the need for robust security measures alongside legal adherence. ([Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxQUHUtVmUwb0VxaWMzNmdIMGVubHQzdTVlTXRQbTNYU0hESHBQbXF3TmRvdUVlam1nbndmUktnWS13VnZxaXU2OURFcHc2b0V5d1VrLUJqR3pid0VyWjNUNWtoUmhIVkl3SDV0NjUtZHNqVWw0NUItbnNmTDcyQ3MzUmFOd1Y0cnMtbnRJUmJHbjJmNHFOcWstTXJUb0NrVzA1TExRZA?oc=5), [Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxOSDZVcFlrZTAzVy1CcjlnOXM4dEpTbklGcmV3YU1OSUgzUlgtSWxqNWxaVTRvTFg2VnZTemJtSDduUEhfLVZQUS01YS01Nl9rc3dMdm5ianBBd3hFaGJTOHNXZ2hKQzZZT1NvWXhneDBjdEVfX1h3TW5OekFDNGZnUFIzbw?oc=5))

The DPDPA's introduction of "Consent Managers" is particularly relevant for Global Capability Centres (GCCs) operating in India, as it mandates a structured approach to managing user consent for data processing. This mechanism aims to empower individuals with greater control over their personal data. ([Source](https://news.google.?oc=5))

In a proactive move, WhatsApp is testing a date-of-birth feature in India, preparing to comply with the DPDPA's upcoming age-verification requirements. This indicates a tangible response from major platforms to adapt to the new regulatory landscape. ([Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxPb05OdzBudlRxNmgwNzFpM213b19ZYXJReEpOelRXY0lNOVQ3emJsdHdTT3JRTzRNejhHcGtqNWg4S3g4RHBKYl9vR3pIb3FsRzgwcHh3SDhKbm5QSWdTem85dUlrZnZqb1hQLWdVTVAyblExX0tIdUFTWlZOQ1VXOVFndEpzaHpjZnAwRWFLTUVqWHNJOXJ3WDJQMFQwQ3BXQU9zbWJFMDdEcU0xUmdmc1B1cw?oc=5), [Source](https://news.google.?oc=5))

## India: DPDPA Interpretations & Challenges

The Supreme Court has sought a response from the Centre regarding Public Interest Litigations (PILs) challenging various provisions of the DPDPA, indicating potential judicial scrutiny of the Act's constitutional validity. This legal challenge could influence the future interpretation and enforcement of the law.
